name: Desires Of Your Heart
overview: Scripture reveals that the desires of our hearts are intimately connected to our relationship with the Lord. As Psalms 37:4 encourages, delighting in the Lord aligns our desires with His will, resulting in Him granting those desires. Trusting and committing our ways to God, as emphasized in Psalms 37:5 and Proverbs 3:5, assures that He will bring our heartfelt requests to pass. The Psalms further affirm that God fulfills the counsel and desires He has placed within us when we seek Him sincerely.
